summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting a court decision in a warrant lawsuit against Getty Images Holdings. Plaintiffs secured partial summary judgment on warrants; the court will direct entry of judgment after authorizations are provided by August 10, 2026. The claimed damages are $67.8 million plus pre-judgment interest, which the company had already reserved. This is a litigation update, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms, no M&A, no capital return, or other corporate event that would fit a special-situations category.
